text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing with Hishi 
Akebono, we talked about that pottery 
class. She was eager, saying she had 
already booked the next session.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, since then, I've watched tons of 
videos on how to use a pottery wheel, and 
I studied the tricks of the trade a bit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I don't expect to become a master 
overnight, but I hope I'm at least better 
than before!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Teacher, I designed it just the way I 
envisioned... but is there anything I 
could do to make it even better?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Like, from a pottery perspective, this is 
the right answer!

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to overthink it. Doesn't 
everything start with being curious and 
growing to like it?

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
There are no right answers in 
craftsmanship. Just give form to what you 
want to create. That's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: There is no right answer...

text_block_list.name: Potter
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. That’s precisely why finding the 
answer within yourself isn't easy. Haha, 
I’m still in training myself.”
choice_data_list: It's a lot like cooking, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. There's no single right way or 
absolute answer for seasoning or shape... 
The most important thing is that it tastes 
good and brings satisfaction...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I can't put it into words very well, 
but... yeah! I feel like I've grabbed 
onto... the knack of the feeling, or 
something!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ Alriiiight! I feel like I can make 
something really satisfying now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to make an earthenware pot 
that cooks the tastiest hot pot meals 
ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Hishi Akebono spun the pottery wheel, 
her serious expression softened into the 
warm look she wore when cooking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It didn't turn out quite like the design, 
but it ended up as an earthenware pot with 
a gentle, similar contour.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It ended up way smaller than planned, and 
the shape is a bit different too, but... 
it turned out pretty great, right, 
Trainer?!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I can't wait to see how it bakes!
Yeah, I can't wait to see how it bakes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Once it's finished, let's go pick 
it up together☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you know, after watching 
pottery wheel videos, I tried cooking a 
bunch of things using recipes I made back 
when I was a kid!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And then, there were so many things that 
caught my eye, like 'it'd taste so good 
with this in it,' or 'it'd look so pretty 
if I did that!'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Still, back then, Mom and Dad never 
once told me, 'You have to do this.'
choice_data_list: You were watching over me, weren't you?
You were watching over me, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It really felt like everyone was 
cheering for me to do the absolute best 
that I could!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to overthink it, right? I'm 
sure once you come to love it, the things 
you notice will just naturally multiply!
choice_data_list: It's the same as a trainer's job, huh.

It's the same as a trainer's job, isn't 
it?
That's what growing up is all about.
That's what growing up is all about.
What's Akebono's Favorite Thing Right Now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to overthink it, right? I'm 
sure once you come to love it, the things 
you notice will just naturally multiply!
choice_data_list: It's the same as a trainer's job, huh.

It's the same as a trainer's job, isn't 
it?
That's what growing up is all about.
That's what growing up is all about.
What's Akebono's Favorite Thing Right Now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The same as your job, Trainer...? Hmm, 
does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through countless experiences, you come to 
love this job and learn so much about it. 
And because you love it, you notice more 
and more things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was about to tell them that whether it's 
cooking or pottery, anything else might 
not be so different, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see! If Trainer loves me a whole bunch, 
that means you'll become an even more 
amazing Trainer, right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Then I gotta work extra hard! I need to 
make Trainer like me even more and more☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not quite... wait, or maybe that's 
actually right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unsure of how to respond, seeing Hishi 
Akebono smiling so happily made me simply 
nod along in agreement.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Growth! The more you love it, the more you 
grow—I think that's super wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna love everything even more! 
Cooking, sumo, training, Trainer— every 
single bit of it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, I feel like I can grow tons 
and tons, and get waaay bigger than I am 
right now! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. The things I love naturally keep 
multiplying every day, so they're growing 
bigger and bigger♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her beaming smile was contagious, and I 
couldn't help smiling too on our way home 
with Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Huh, number 1!? Whoa, what could it be!?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I love eating, and I love cooking! Plus 
running... and pottery was really fun too! 
And then, and then—!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You love your dad and mom, and your 
Trainer, and your friends, right? And 
also...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, no way~!! I can't choose~! You're 
all number one! I love you all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There are looooads of other ones! Like, 
for example—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Listening to her endless declarations of 
love, we swayed along on the train ride 
home."
